character_types: two young women on a bench
visual_synopsis: A patrolman in a light blue summer uniform strolls a sunlit park, stops for a drink at a stone fountain, then spots a young man in a black shirt lounging on the grass and squats over him for a long shakedown, gesturing at the lawn and at papers in his hand. The young man eventually stands up and argues back until the cop backs off and walks away, leaving him alone in the park glancing at a little girl on the lawn and two women on a bench before he delivers a closing piece to camera.
